topic: Kurkov's universal quadratic recursion for logarithmic polynomials
title: An alternative proof of Kurkov's logarithmic-polynomial recursion and its Leonov–Shiryaev interpretation

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We give an alternative proof of Mikhail Kurkov's conjecture in OEIS A263634, FORMULA of 30 March 2025 (entry revision #166, 5 November 2025), identifying its all-column array as a specialization of the Leonov–Shiryaev product-cumulant theorem (1959). The quotient method appears in xpaul (2019), and IV_ (2020) connects its first column to logarithmic polynomials. For Kurkov's quadratic recursive array we establish R(n,k)=(n-1)![t^(n-1)]F^(k)(t)/F(t), where F(t)=1+sum_(i>=1)x_i t^i/i!. Differentiating these quotients gives the recurrence directly. We also rederive classical coefficient and Appell identities, correct a factorial normalization in the source's Appell comments, and recover the exponential-polynomial exception of Craven and Csordas (1994).
summary: An alternative formal-series proof of Kurkov's logarithmic-polynomial recursion in every positive column, with its classical Leonov–Shiryaev mixed-cumulant interpretation, coefficient and Appell consequences, corrected power-sum normalization, and the known exponential-polynomial exception to simple Appell zeros.
